desc: Analyze how removing one string affects prefix counts and define a data structure to track counts per prefix.
Design an efficient method to compute, for every prefix node, the largest depth achievable with at least k strings after each possible removal.

Implement trie + Euler-interval (built-in L/R for c==k nodes) + suffix/prefix max arrays, avoiding recursion; answer per terminal = max(base from c>k nodes, best c==k node whose subtree excludes the terminal).
Handle edge cases: k=1, n==k (all zeros), duplicate words, words that are prefixes of others, deep recursion (iterative everywhere).
Verify on Examples 1 and 2 and confirm O(total_length) complexity.
